I'm a Charlotte-based project manager and creative technologist. I move comfortably between the field and the screen — coordinating construction projects and AutoCAD layouts one week, building front-end interfaces and 3D scenes the next.

The common thread is execution: taking an ambiguous goal and turning it into something real, polished, and finished. I care about the details most people skip, because that's usually where the difference lives.

Adams Glen Community Pool

DR Horton · Mauldin, SC · 2024

A 61,700-gallon commercial community pool for DR Horton’s Adams Glen development. At Carolina Pools I produced the full construction drawing set in AutoCAD — ten sheets spanning the site plan, shell dimensions and layout, equipment room, plumbing, sections, and deck & drainage — detailed to meet SC DHEC Regulation 61-51 and the 2021 South Carolina building codes for permitting.

Wildbrook Village Entrance Monument

DR Horton · Waynesville, NC · 2024

An illuminated stone entrance monument with an integrated water feature for DR Horton’s Wildbrook Village. At Carolina Pools I drafted the full construction set in AutoCAD — cover, construction notes, fountain dimensions, and electrical and plumbing layouts — covering the nine-foot stone-veneer tower, its sheer-descent waterfall and submersible pump, and low-voltage sign lighting, detailed to the 2018 NC Building Code.
